title: The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 does not have authorisation checks in some of its AJAX actions, allowing…
description: The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin versions before 4.0.1 lack authorization checks in certain AJAX actions. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated users to reorder arbitrary posts, including drafts, private posts, and navigation menu items, as well as reorder taxonomy terms when term ordering is enabled.
